body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

All findings rejected: feature description/plan mismatch (intentional scope decision), branch includes prior unrelated commits (OOS), nit on helper asymmetry (nit-only), and pre-existing code issues (OOS). No real code bugs found — reviewer finding on whitespace-only lines was a false positive (jq exits 0 for whitespace-only input).
